BIDEN.title: Sleepy Joe
BIDEN.description:
Here's the deal, folks: he's not asleep, he's resting his eyes.
Let him nod off, and Dark Brandon wakes up.
BIDEN.cardsModifierDescription: Sleepy Joe cards will now appear in rewards and shops.
BIDEN.eventDeathPrevention: C'mon, man. Not today. Not like this.
BIDEN.goldMonologue: [sine]Gold, huh? Here's the deal: I'd trade it all for one chocolate chip cone...[/sine]
BIDEN.aromaPrinciple: [sine][gold]Folks, we're going to climb this Spire. No joke.[/gold][/sine]
BIDEN.banter.alive.endTurnPing: C'mon, pal, end the turn. I could use a nap.
BIDEN.unlockText: Play a run as {Prerequisite} to unlock.
